title: About Me
text: I am an engineer that leads with creativity! My name is Mitzi, welcome to the website. Try using the arrow keys to explore - everything you see is hand pixeled and wired up with Kaplay and React!

title: Contacts
text: Try clicking the contact buttons to contact me by email or linkedin - or check out my github!

title: Surprise?
text: 'S' stands for surprise - it also stands for 'skill'. I wonder what happens if you press 'S'? I wonder what happens if you press it again?

title: Have Fun!
text: I hope you have fun playing around in this environment, it's a labor of love.
